page.layout: One title page, centred. From top to bottom: a line of spaced capitals (author's name); a faint line in smaller type; the large word OPERUM; TOMUS TERTIUS in spaced capitals; a small italic-looking block of two lines; the word ROMANO in large spaced capitals; a central engraving (a snake coiled around a staff, with a banner); the imprint AMSTELÆDAMI in spaced capitals; and a last line naming the publisher, GERARDUS BORTIUS.
page.notes: The title page is set in very pale blue ink, which is faint and partly lost in the scan. The top author line and the small lines above and below OPERUM can only be partly made out, so they are marked illegible. The publisher line, GERARDUS BORTIUS with a sub-sign and place, is also barely legible. The engraving shows a snake coiled round a staff on a pedestal, with a small banner bearing an inscription that cannot be read. The handwritten number at the foot and the red mark at the lower right are not printed text and are left out. Stains and show-through have been ignored.
